all_operand_assessments.historical_frontier_context: The actual BOC1913 Noqui–Kwango protocol distinguishes thalwegs, pillar lines, and straight segments and gives its annex maps priority in textual conflicts. Jentgen’s 1925 verification and 1927 changes limit reliance on older descriptions. These interstate provisions do not determine municipal interior limits or establish a held cell’s side.
all_operand_assessments.construction: The original native family is a simplified geoBoundaries USCB product. The actual 2019 Census comparator documents HDX ADM2 input, a Lovua split, alignment with 2018 LSIB, and dissolution to ADM1. Its identity cannot be assumed for each exact sourceData or native feature.
all_operand_assessments.mismatch_evidence: Its processing differs from COD atlas digitization, but no segment-specific displacement has been demonstrated for these keys.
all_operand_assessments.reasonable_failed_qualification: The exact AGO ADM1 PR1352 source archive remains restricted and unread. Prior Uige coordinate equality cannot transfer to Zaire, Cabinda, or Lunda features. The available comparator establishes processing without resolving this exact relation.
all_operand_assessments.remaining_step: Use the actual native attribution. Further source work must address the applicable exact feature or segment and respect the existing restriction.
all_operand_assessments.qualification_status: empty kinds under native predicate; retained original operand, not semantic clearance

argument.native_question: All 25 exact Songololo keys have the native interior kind for original AGO ADM1 Zaire, feature ordinal 17, negative ordinal 1. The COD target remains in the original frozen land support. The other four retained operands have empty kinds at these keys. This isolates a specific incompatible source representation; it does not decide sovereignty or erase the original operands.
argument.historical_rule: Actual BOC1913 Section B, printed 955–965, describes Noqui–Kwango using surveyed markers, straight lines, and the Luvo, Lungezy, and Luvemba thalwegs. Printed 964–965 gives the annex trace priority over inconsistent text. Actual Jentgen pages 77–78 describe subsequent 1924/1925 verification and 1927 Mpozo–Duizi changes. Consequently a generic 1891 parallel, generic river line, or a marker from another segment cannot qualify this Zaire exclusion.
argument.source_construction: The exact native feature identity and geometry hash are preserved. Its named-feature relation to the 2019 Census Zaire record is documented; that comparator was processed from HDX ADM2 through the Lovua split, LSIB alignment, and ADM1 dissolution. This is specific evidence about the comparator family, not proof that exact Zaire sourceData coordinates or the disputed segment match it. COD’s source documents atlas digitization, watercourse splitting, topology and name validation, and assignment of undefined projection to WGS84; it gives no exact frontier edge convention.
argument.mismatch_assessment: The native interior result establishes overlap in the consumed representation. No executed source reading establishes which of the COD or Zaire exported edges is displaced, nor a defensible clearance of these 25 cells. Different construction histories alone are not such evidence. Uige’s inherited coordinate comparison cannot transfer to Zaire.
argument.reasonable_failed_qualification: The original 1913 text was obtained and read after overcoming the reader size limit through a separately approved download; relevant pages were visually checked. Its specifically named maps were sought in the retained volume using text and low-text page inspection, without finding an applicable annex. The official Cartothèque inventory locates Noqui–Kwango sheets rather than resolving their fine controls. The exact AGO ADM1 raw route remains restricted and was not retried. The bounded five-root local search found the descriptor and comparators, but no exact original ZIP. A 2017 OCHA Songololo map page returned 403 and remains stopped.
argument.proposal_basis: The proposed unresolved treatment is based on actual primary instrument reading, source construction comparison, targeted annex and custody investigation, and failed exact-source qualification—not the native overlap or absent metadata alone. The evidence supports submitting these exact 25 cells for independent consideration as extensively researched but still unresolved. It does not claim every source opportunity is exhausted.
argument.remaining_finite_step: A lawful already-retained exact AGO ADM1 source body, if later found, could settle the Zaire archive/output relation. The specific cartographic custody lead is State Archives portfolio 35/card 22, DEL.L-C.5A-C plus 5BIS B-D, Noqui–Kwango annex sheets; reading an applicable sheet could test the surveyed segment. No exact accessible sheet body was identified in the completed work. Custodian contact has not been authorized or sent.
argument.scope_exclusions: Cabinda Section A, Kasai survey controls, and Uige-specific equivalence are not used to decide the Zaire contact. Empty municipal kinds are only native-predicate absence.
